title: Why I *won't* tell you what you want to hear
description:
A mission statement.

I'm taking you beyond the "what" of the news cycle and into the "so what" and "now what" -- why a specific piece of news actually matters to you and what to look for next.

Subscribe and join me on this journey!
transcript: I want to tell you what makes this channel unique. It's not that I used towork at CNN or the Washington Post. I've spent decades in mainstream media.That's not the point. Here it is. Unlike lots and lots and lots of politicschannels on YouTube. I am not going to tell you what you want to hear because Iknow that will get me more subscribers or make me more money. I am going totell you what I think you need to hear. And what that means is this. I pledge toyou. I will always shoot you straight. I will always be authentic. I will alwaysbe transparent. I will always tell you why I think what I think, the possibleargument against what I think, and why you don't always need to agree with me.In fact, you shouldn't agree with me all this time. If subscribing to thischannel means you have to agree with everything I say, don't. You shouldsubscribe to this channel if you want to hear unvarnished takes on politics.Whether that's good for Republicans or good for Democrats or good for neitherof them, I'm going to give it to you how I think about it every single day havingspent decades watching, listening, and reading about politics. That's what I'mdoing. I want to give the political news and analysis you need in a form that Ihope entertains you, but not give you only what you want to hear. I thinkthat's the problem with this country. We have way too many people in thepolitical space telling you what you want to hear because they know that ifthey tell you what you want to hear, you're going to like them. You're goingto subscribe to them. You're going to give them money. You're going to makethem a bigger deal. I get it. It's a smart business model. Maybe I'm not thatsmart a businessman, but what I am is someone absolutely and totally committedto bringing you the news and analysis of the day, every day, in a way that ishonest, authentic, and transparent. That's what I care about. That's whatI'm going to continue to do whether or not it's the right business decision.It's the right decision for me, I think, for journalism, for politics, and forthis country. So, I'm going to keep doing it. I hope I can count on yoursupport. I hope you subscribe to me, and I hope that you do it knowing you're notgoing to agree with me on everything. And that's not only okay, that's a very,very good thing. Thanks for listening. Check out my content. I appreciate you.
